text: Use simple reserved example addresses in synthetic MIME fixtures unless a specific address behavior is under test. D211998 requested @Test or @example.org instead of incidental message addresses; the accepted fixture uses john@example.com. Keep enough MIME headers/body to reproduce the behavior, including inline image relationships and contentId when needed. This is a scoped fixture-writing convention, not proof that every existing fixture follows it.
title: MIME regression fixtures should use reserved example addresses and clear content
